bio: Develops the MATTO multi-conjugate adaptive-optics test bench and its DAO4MATTO real-time control system.
long_bio: Alessandro develops the MATTO multi-conjugate adaptive-optics laboratory at INAF Padova. His work includes the DAO4MATTO real-time control architecture, combining laboratory hardware, wavefront sensing and deformable-mirror control. The facility is designed to test several MCAO configurations and compare new control approaches before they are adopted by astronomical observatories.
